Recursive partitioning based on psychometric models, employing the general MOB algorithm (from package partykit) to obtain Bradley-Terry trees, Rasch trees, rating scale and partial credit trees, and MPT trees, trees for 1PL, 2PL, 3PL and 4PL models and generalized partial credit models.

name: r-psychotree
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.16-3" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-psychotree
  version: "{{ version|replace("-", "_") }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/psychotree_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/psychotree/psychotree_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e44bb3b43d6c5515621eed559a065efb01ab5623f73751d970e867076f5f7a02

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-formula
    - r-partykit >=1.2_9
    - r-psychotools >=0.7_1
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-formula
    - r-partykit >=1.2_9
    - r-psychotools >=0.7_1

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('psychotree')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('psychotree')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://zeileis.codeberg.page/psychotree/
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  summary: Recursive partitioning based on psychometric models, employing the general MOB algorithm
    (from package partykit) to obtain Bradley-Terry trees, Rasch trees, rating scale
    and partial credit trees, and MPT trees, trees for 1PL, 2PL, 3PL and 4PL models
    and generalized partial credit models.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
